hypothesis: Failure fetching/decoding a speech URL must be separated from actual audio output. Valid in-memory PCM is insufficient evidence of a valid playback resource.

comparison.method: Temporary one-shot automation after automation_reloaded; self-disable without stopping its own actions; play local media file to HomePod, then local Voice PE announcement. Remove after evidence. HomePod resolves local media to a filesystem path rather than InternetSource.
